Item Number: C.10.c.
Subject:
Contract award for Caterpillar Generator Maintenance and Repair Services for various City Divisions,
Ring Power Corporation, Palm Bay, FL - estimated annual amount of $285,000 and an estimated
contract amount of $1,710,000.
Background/Consideration:
The City uses an annual maintenance and repair contract to service Caterpillar generators at various
City facilities. Routine preventative maintenance and scheduled or unscheduled repair services for
generators are necessary to maintain the proper working order of this vital equipment. These
generators are located at various Water Production locations, both Water Reclamation Facilities, the
City Hall building, the Fleet Maintenance building, the Streets/Parks building, and the Joseph
Pellicano Law Enforcement Center. This is a sole source purchase.
Contract/Solicitation:
This is a sole source contract. A completed sole source form is attached. This contract will
commence on October 17, 2026, and has five, 12-month renewals available.
Fiscal/Budget Impact:
Funding is budgeted in the following operating expense accounts. The costs below represent the
estimated annual cost for each division.
62100533-534000 (Water Production-Other Contract Services) and 62100533-546000 (Water
Production-Repair & Maintenance) - $150,000
63100535-534000 (Water Reclamation-Other Contract Services) - $90,000
64000519-534000 (Facilities-Other Contract Services) - $10,000
64500541-534000 (Streets-Other Contract Services) - $5,000
64900519-546000 (Fleet-Repair & Maintenance) - $5,000
44000521-534000 (Police Support-Other Contract Services) - $25,000
Requested Action:
Approval of contract award for Caterpillar Generator Maintenance and Repair Services, Ring Power
Corporation, Palm Bay, FL - estimated annual amount of $285,000 and an estimated contract
amount of $1,710,000.

Item Number: C.9.b.
Subject:
Purchase of seven replacement Variable Frequency Drives, for D.B. Lee and Grant Street Water
Reclamation Facilities.
Background/Consideration:
The seven (7) replacement Variable Frequency Drives (VFDs) are integral to the wastewater
treatment system as they allow for the monitoring, control and safe operation of all associated
equipment. The VFDs will be programmed and integrated into the existing Supervisory Control and
Data Acquisition (SCADA) system by Rexel USA, Inc. as part of this purchase. All the VFDs at the
Water Reclamation facility are Allen-Bradley/Rockwell Automation equipment. Rexel USA, Inc. is the
sole source for Allen-Bradley/Rockwell Automation equipment. Price includes freight and warranty of
one year. Lead time for delivery is 10 to 12 weeks.
Contract/Solicitation:
This is a sole source purchase. A completed sole source form is attached.
Fiscal/Budget Impact:
Funding is available in operating account 63100535-564000 - Water Reclamation-Machinery and
Equipment.

Water Reclamation Facilities, Rexel USA, Inc., Melbourne, FL - total estimated cost of $383,777.

Melbourne City Council
November 25, 2025
City Manager's Item Report
Department: Parks & Recreation
Presenter: Nikki Caldwell
Council District: N/A

Quasi-judicial Item (Disclosure Required): No

Item Number: C.10.e.
Subject:
Increase to existing purchase orders at Crane Creek Reserve Golf Course Harbor City Golf Course
for chemicals and fertilizers.
Background/Consideration:
Chemicals and fertilizers are necessary to maintain the greens, tees, and fairways at the golf
courses. The turf needs various products depending on weather, water, pests, weeds, and other
factors during the year.
In 2023, City Council approved a waiver to the formal bid requirements for fertilizer and chemicals
after the contracted vendors declined to renew their contracts. The vendors cited market volatility,
cost increases in material and freight, and their inability to guarantee pricing for the upcoming
renewal period. Therefore, staff will purchase using sole source vendors, agency pricing, and quotes
for remaining items as it is unknown exactly which chemicals are needed throughout the year and
what company the chemical will ultimately be procured from.
Purchase Order No. 26000291 for Crane Creek Reserve Golf Course needs $55,000 added (total
Purchase Order amount $70,000) for the following chemicals and fertilizers: Green Edge Fertilizer,
Lesco Drax Fungicide, and Lesco Hawkeye Surfectant that are proprietary blends. We are
anticipating needing additional chemicals through the remainder of the fiscal year.
Purchase Order No. 26000292 for Harbor City Golf Course needs $55,000 added (total Purchase
Order amount $70,000) for the following chemicals and fertilizers: Green Edge Fertilizer, Lesco Drax
Fungicide, and Lesco Hawkeye Surfectant that are proprietary blends.
A sole source request form is attached for the items that are proprietary with an estimated spend of
$40,000. We will obtain quotes for other products and will purchase from the lowest priced vendor. If
SiteOne is lowest, we will purchase from them using this blanket Purchase Order.
Contract/Solicitation:
Some products are sole source and a sole source form is attached.
Fiscal/Budget Impact:
Funding is available in accounts 37500572-552070 and 37700572-552070.
Requested Action:
Approval of increase to existing blanket purchase orders by $55,000 each for Crane Creek Reserve
Golf Course and Harbor City Golf Course for chemicals and fertilizers, SiteOne Landscape Supply,
LLC Palm Bay, FL - total increase of $110,000.

Melbourne City Council
November 25, 2025
City Manager's Item Report
Department: Financial Services
Presenter: Ross McGinn
Council District: N/A
Reading Number: N/A
Quasi-judicial Item (Disclosure Required): No
Public Hearing: No
Item Number: C.10.k.
Subject:
Purchase of Beacon Mobile Hosting Fees, Badger Meter, Inc., Milwaukee, WI - estimated annual
cost of $600,000.
Background/Consideration:
The City utilizes the Beacon software package offered by Badger Meter, Inc., the City's vendor for
water meters and water meter parts. This software assists in the conversion of raw usage data to
billable amounts for water, wastewater, and reclaimed water services. The majority of the City's
meter inventory transmits data via transponders and is picked up by equipment attached to vehicles
driven by Meter Services staff for upload into the Beacon software. As these transponders meet the
end of their useful life, staff has been retrofitting our current meters with cellular-capable endpoints
which can transmit usage data remotely, eventually eliminating the need for staff to drive equipment
around the City and providing near real-time data to identify and address leaks faster.
Use of the Beacon software is billed to the City on a per meter, per month basis. The City pays $0.04
per meter, and an additional $0.81 per cellular capable meter, as established via the original sole
source quote received from software implementation in April 2020. Based on the most recent billing
information, the City has 59,989 meters, with 47,153 meters with cellular capabilities, which equates
to roughly $1,886 in hosting fees and $38,194 in cellular fees per month. The increase in cellular
capable meters has necessitated the need for Council to authorize an annual spend based on
thresholds established in the City's Procurement Manual.
Using the most recent billing information and anticipating an increase as more meters are retrofitted,
staff is recommending an annual spend of approximately $600,000 for FY 2026.
Contract/Solicitation:
This is a sole source purchase. A completed sole source form is attached.
Fiscal/Budget Impact:
There is sufficient funding in 61200536-534000 - Other Contract Services.
Requested Action:
Approval of purchase of Beacon Mobile Hosting Fees, Badger Meter, Inc. Milwaukee, WI - estimated
annual cost of $600,000.
